races.title: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict: TREDEGAR SQUARE won't be inconvenienced by 6f given how he's shaped so far and is taken to build on his promising winning debut at the second attempt here. Brave Country is the obvious threat, though Livorno may well take a big step forward this time. TREDEGAR SQUARE BRAVE COUNTRY (IRE) LIVORNO

races.title: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict: ANGEL FOOTSTEPS has been off the track since finishing second at Redcar in the spring but she represents a good yard and in receipt of weight from the rest in an ordinary-looking novice, she could be the answer. Amandari needs to learn how to settle but he's certainly in the right hands, with King's Flight and Tuxedo Black both appealing newcomers. ANGEL FOOTSTEPS AMANDARI (IRE) KING'S FLIGHT

races.title: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Nursery
races.verdict: NIGHTBLOOM improved markedly for the step up to this trip last time and, with the form having been franked, she looks well capable of following up at the expense of a couple dropping in grade. Divine Whisper should find this level more to her liking, while Lady Blanche has strong form to her name if fit enough to do herself justice on first outing since May. NIGHTBLOOM (IRE) DIVINE WHISPER LADY BLANCHE (IRE)

races.title: Unibet's New VAR Goal Guarantee Nursery
races.verdict: DIVINE RHYTHM may well have gone backwards from an encouraging debut last time, but a couple of in-frame efforts mean he can make this quick switch to nurseries. In top hands switched to all-weather, he gets the verdict over Q T Boy , who went close to doubling his tally at Bath recently and now makes his all-weather debut. The experienced Global Success rounds off the shortlist. DIVINE RHYTHM (IRE) Q T BOY GLOBAL SUCCESS (IRE)

races.title: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: STERLING COOPER improved markedly when third at Newmarket in September, shaping as if this step up to 1m will suit, and another step forward should see him off the mark. Lady Margo ran too green when fourth on debut over C&D last month but should be sharper for the experience, while Gilder Roy can prove a threat if coping with the drop back in trip. STERLING COOPER (IRE) LADY MARGO (IRE) GILDER ROY

races.title: Try Unibet's New VAR Goal Guarantee Handicap
races.verdict: PALLADAS looked an exciting prospect when winning his first 2 starts on all-weather, including over C&D, and can resume his progress back up to 1m faced with more exposed rivals. Having been gelded, Princling shaped encouragingly when an unlucky third at Ascot last time and is another 3-y-o to note, while Hard Endeavor has a C&D win to his name and should be suited by the drop back to this trip. PALLADAS PRINCLING HARD ENDEAVOR (FR)

races.title: Unibet Interactive Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: ZACHARY HICKES is the least exposed of these and found further progress when justifying strong market confidence at Wolverhampton 36 days ago. He's up 3 lb but should have more to offer so is fancied to defy the rise with the step up to 2m likely to suit. Tarbat Ness has been in excellent form with 4 wins this year and drew clear at Southwell, so is feared most. ZACHARY HICKES TARBAT NESS SQUIRE DANAGHER

races.title: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Handicap
races.verdict: ENACTING shaped very well on recent comeback run and is taken to prove too good for more exposed rivals. Caragio has won twice at this track in recent weeks and moved through the race as if still on a winnable mark when second at Newmarket 18 days ago so is set to prove the biggest danger, while Chalk Mountain will be well suited by a well-run race and can figure if getting the breaks. ENACTING (IRE) CARAGIO (IRE) CHALK MOUNTAIN

races.title: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap
races.verdict: CROWN OF CROWNS is a lightly-raced filly who built on debut promise when winning a Southwell novice in October, and whilst she still showed some greenness that day, she's bred to stay well and can make a winning handicap debut. Snooker Mccrew is thriving so is hard to discount, though does have stamina to prove, while Midnight Media looks capable of going well once again. CROWN OF CROWNS SNOOKER MCCREW MIDNIGHT MEDIA
